notes.title: Parasite Echo v0.0.1 RELEASE 🚀
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580070/4f609ae941bb15b21501d1b28a46005dce2f5906.png"][/img][/p][p][b]🚀 The first version of [i]Parasite Echo[/i] is here![/b][/p][p]After 3 months of full focus and countless late nights, I’m proud to finally share this first build with you.[/p][p]Progress has been fast — faster than I expected — and I’ve built a strong foundation to expand the game in future updates. What started as a prototype has quickly become a project I’m genuinely passionate about. I’m giving it everything I’ve got — and it shows.[/p][p]If you’ve played my previous games, you’ll notice the difference right away: this early version already surpasses many of my completed works. And this is just the beginning.[/p][p]I truly hope you enjoy it. If you want to see this game reach its full potential — with more depth, more scenes, more NSFW content, more everything — please consider supporting the project. Without your help, I won’t be able to keep dedicating the time it deserves.[/p][p]If we grow this together, [i]Parasite Echo[/i] will become something truly special.[/p][p]Thank you for being here — and enjoy the game! 🦠[/p][p][i]⚠ Please remember that this is an alpha build[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]You can play the game on [url="https://patreon.com/TheAesthetik?utm_medium=unknown&utm_source=join_link&utm_campaign=creatorshare_creator&utm_content=copyLink"]Patreon[/url] or [url="https://subscribestar.adult/theaesthetik"]Suscribestar[/url][/b][/p][p][/p]
